entities.summary: Koca Yusuf Pasha was an Ottoman statesman. He was grand vizier from 25 January 1786 to 28 May 1789, and Kapudan Pasha after 19 December 1789. He became grand vizier again, this time serving from 12 February 1791 until mid-1792. He is considered to be one of the best Ottoman commanders of his time period.
